title: Plans to Make Classification of Etomidate as Class C Drug Permanent
what_it_is: Plans to Make Classification of Etomidate as Class C Drug Permanent

sections.label: Etomidate temporary listing under MDA
sections.summary: Etomidate was temporarily listed under the MDA as evidence of long-term addictiveness is insufficient and it is not a UN controlled drug.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Every candidate substance is carefully evaluated and there must be robust scientific evidence of significant harm and addictiveness before we will list it.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Given that the abuse of etomidate is a relatively recent development, there is insufficient evidence of its long-term addictiveness for now.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: It has not been proscribed as a controlled drug under the UN Drug Conventions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: However, as the etomidate situation was deemed urgent, the Government decided to temporarily list it under the MDA to enhance the legislative powers available for enforcement and rehabilitation, pending the Ministry of Health strengthening its legislation to deal with vapes, including those with more harmful substances like etomidate.

sections.label: Etomidate psychiatric and physical harms
sections.summary: Etomidate causes serious psychiatric effects like suicidal feelings and physical effects including confusion, loss of consciousness and fatal vital function disruption.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Essentially, for the harms with regard to its effects, you can term it as psychiatric effects, very serious psychiatric effects like feeling suicidal; and also there are physical effects, like the feeling of confusion, loss of consciousness, uncontrolled movement and disruption of vital body functions, for example, irregular heart rhythms, abnormal blood pressure, breathing difficulties and hormone imbalances; and some can be very fatal.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: What we do is, for the psychoactive effects, for example, we have amended the MDA.

sections.label: Changing landscape with vapes and etomidate
sections.summary: With substances like etomidate and vapes, the landscape is changing and this will be discussed with counterparts.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: With the recent advent of substances like etomidate, certainly the landscape would be changing.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: And with vapes coming on board, it is something that we will certainly discuss with our counterparts and see how we can not only have that evidence, but also look at how we can stay relevant in the current context.
